text: {"lessons":["I sold every stock after a gain, which felt rewarding; next time I’ll judge whether to sell by its future prospects and my overall plan, not by my average cost or the pleasure of locking in a gain.","I should treat all five positions as parts of one portfolio, not separate accounts where a loss feels like a mistake to avoid admitting; a loss alone is not a reason to hold.","Past price moves do not predict future moves, and I don’t need to trade each month: I’ll act only when a reasoned change in my plan warrants it."]}
